## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 2-fascicle text is the Tang-period lecture-record on the *[Śrīmālā-siṃha-nāda-sūtra](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6f/KR6f0045)* by the great Yogācāra-school master [窺基](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%AA%BA%E5%9F%BA) Kuījī (632–682), recorded by his disciple [義令](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%BE%A9%E4%BB%A4) Yìlìng. The catalog meta lists "大乘" as author, which appears to be a placeholder term referring to the *Mahāyāna* doctrinal tradition rather than a personal name; the actual authorial attribution is to Kuījī.

**Abstract**

The bracket adopted here (660 – 682) reflects [窺基](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%AA%BA%E5%9F%BA) Kuījī's mature scholarly period. The work documents Kuījī's Yogācāra-school reading of the *Śrīmālā* and its *tathāgatagarbha* doctrine — an unusual case of an explicitly Yogācāra master commenting on a foundational *tathāgatagarbha* sūtra.

The work is preserved in the Manji *Xù zàng jīng* (X352) collection.
